manual.warning_signs.line2: Factories and warehouses are often grimy, unsafe, and riddled with chemicals and steam clouding the air.{0}
manual.warning_signs.line3: If reducing these hazards is inefficient, newly standardized Warning Signs can be used to warn of dangers instead.
manual.warning_signs.line4: {0}Warning signs can be crafted from any metal backing plate and yellow dye, to make sure the signs are visible on gloomy factory floors.{1}
manual.warning_signs.line5: Signs can be placed on any vertical block face, but cannot be placed on the floor or on the ceiling.{0}
manual.warning_signs.line6: Using a §2glow ink sack§r on a placed sign will make it emit a low amount of light.
